The registry class code Sav44-02 and the contemporaneous Camp Savage interpreter description are preserved as an Army training and assignment pathway.

affiliations.date_precision: NARA explicitly describes Bessony as on detached service from the French Army to OSS; the indexed lieutenant and reported captain ranks may reflect different dates and require personnel-file review.

affiliations.date_precision: The registry places Betsui in class Sav44-02 and records CBI and OSS Detachment 101 service; a separate institutional history places him as an interpreter at Camp Savage in August 1944. Exact transfer dates are not stated.
